mapper.select: SELECT * FROM metric_info WHERE datasource_id = #{datasourceId} AND LOWER(metric_key) = LOWER(#{metricKey}) LIMIT 1

SELECT * FROM metric_info WHERE datasource_id = #{datasourceId} AND ( LOWER(name) = LOWER(#{hint}) OR LOWER(aliases) LIKE CONCAT('%', LOWER(#{hint}), '%') OR LOWER(description) LIKE CONCAT('%', LOWER(#{hint}), '%') ) ORDER BY CASE WHEN LOWER(name) = LOWER(#{hint}) THEN 0 ELSE 1 END, id ASC
